name: 福田定史
description: イラストレーター/脚本/演出/アクション/福ラボ🦕最近はデュエマの絵を描いてます。 相方の美希兎🐰⇒(@mikito_flabo)#福ラボ 依頼はDMへ！

works.body:
Hello Mr. Fukuda, my name is Fu∅.
I would like to request a character for my Youtube and X icons.
I'm not very familiar with drawing, so I may not be able to explain myself very well, but I'd appreciate your help.
I would like the character to be male, neutral in gender, with dark blue hair and cool black eyes.
I haven't decided on the clothes, so I would like to leave it up to you.
I've seen your pictures on X, and they are all wonderful, so I'm really looking forward to seeing them! I would be very happy if you could draw as you like! I would be very happy if you could draw as you wish!
